title: Iron Legion group formation template
description: A multi-regiment arrangement (content/group_formations/*.json5) applied by the GroupFormation command (Simulation Spec SIM-FORM-040..042).

gap.description: Metres between regiments; 0 means use formation.group_gap from the rules.

skirmishers_forward.description: Ranged and skirmisher regiments stand formation.skirmish_offset ahead (SIM-FORM-041).

cavalry_flanks.description: Cavalry regiments take the outer positions (SIM-FORM-041).

lines.description: Number of lines for double_line style arrangements.
